## Issue and acceptance criteria

## Implementation

Describe the smallest responsible boundary changed by this pull request.

## Out of scope

List related work deliberately not included.

## Checklist

- [ ] Engineering code, comments and documentation are in English.
- [ ] Spanish student-facing copy remains correctly localised.
- [ ] No secret, personal data, dump or private release evidence is included.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behaviour.
- [ ] Relevant tests and validators pass.
